stories.title: Clubhouse Leader
stories.detail: Steven Wait tops the lot on 41 pts, perched up top like Penrith on the ladder with a month of the season still to run.

stories.title: Someone Call Security
stories.detail: 2 big ones on holes 3 & 8 - the handicapper has questions

stories.title: Runaway
stories.detail: 5 clear at the top - daylight second

stories.title: In the Hunt
stories.detail: 2nd - 5 off the pace

stories.title: The Bolter
stories.detail: Max O'Connell came from the clouds to gain 14 spots, that is finals momentum in a buggy.

stories.title: Welcome to WWCC
stories.detail: Welcome to Wagga Wagga, Reginald Wheeler from Junee GC, and thanks for keeping it in play.

stories.title: Low-Marker Masterclass
stories.detail: Off the stick (3) and 9th - proper ball-striking

stories.title: Reachable Feeling
stories.detail: 2 of the par 5s gave up 3-pointers - length is a weapon

stories.title: Under the Radar
stories.detail: 3 3-pointers+ through the round - not flashy, just effective

stories.title: Open for Business
stories.detail: 5 3-pointers+ from 15 holes - finding the scoreboard everywhere

stories.title: Variety Pack
stories.detail: Wipes, 1s, 2s, 3s - something for everyone on this card

stories.title: Short-Hole Sniper
stories.detail: 2 threes on the par 3s - dialled in with the irons

stories.title: The Complete Package
stories.detail: Wipes, 1s, 2s AND 3s - a round that covers all four food groups

stories.title: Spot Fires
stories.detail: 3 3-pointers+ scattered through the round - keeps finding ways to score

stories.title: Hero to Zero
stories.detail: 3-pointer then a wipe on holes 7 & 8 - feast then famine

stories.title: Settling In
stories.detail: 3 twos in a row on holes 14, 15 & 16 - starting to look comfortable

stories.title: Wipe Artist
stories.detail: 4 wipes in 18 holes - technically a very consistent performance

stories.title: Building Something
stories.detail: 3 twos on holes 14, 15 & 16 - the round is taking shape

stories.title: The Three-Point Farmer
stories.detail: 5 3-pointers+ harvested from the round - relentless

stories.title: Short-Hole Assassin
stories.detail: 3-pointers on 2 of the par 3s - the short holes never stood a chance

stories.title: Steady Eddie
stories.detail: 8 two-pointers, not a wipe in sight - metronomic golf

stories.title: Not Done Yet
stories.detail: Wipe on hole 3, 3-pointer on hole 4 - that's better

stories.title: The Streaker (Not That Kind)
stories.detail: 4 wipes in 18 holes - tough day at the office

stories.title: The 1-Pointer Specialist
stories.detail: 11 1-pointers on the card - the one-point machine is fully operational

stories.title: Finding a Rhythm
stories.detail: 4 twos on the bounce on holes 8-11

stories.title: The Full Experience
stories.detail: Hit every outcome on the card - the golf round as a show bag

stories.title: Perfectly Mediocre
stories.detail: 3 1-pointers straight - one point at a time, every time

stories.title: Not Today, Scoreboard
stories.detail: 4 wipes from 10 holes - the scorecard is mostly fresh air

stories.title: Slipping Away
stories.detail: Owen Whalan slipped 5th to 14th, still finals bound with a bit of polish on the short game.

comingLast.roast: his getaway car has been quietly boxed in, allegedly
pace of 1.3 - the blue balls have started their walk to the bar
on 17 at 1.3 - his playing partners are witnesses now, not opponents
1 point buys freedom - White is pricing it higher by the minute
still swinging on 24 - hope dies on the 18th, usually
in the clubhouse 1 above White - cheering for him from a safe distance
safe by 2 unless the course gets generous late
